description: Public gameplay inventory decisions. Pending means unfinished, not excluded. Related executable scenarios are evidence candidates, not member-level conformance claims. Pure library checks cannot establish native gameplay support.

mineflayer.createBot.reason: The BB thread is already attached to a native body; server connections and account authentication are outside the agreed scope.

mineflayer.Bot.connect.reason: Network connection setup is outside the agreed native-body API scope.

mineflayer.Bot._client.reason: Mineflayer's internal packet client is outside the agreed public gameplay compatibility boundary.

mineflayer.Bot.end.reason: Pinned documentation/source define Minecraft socket disconnection. Server connection APIs are outside the agreed native-body scope; a script has no independent socket and must not disconnect the shared game or BB.

mineflayer.Bot.quit.reason: Pinned documentation/source define Minecraft socket disconnection. Server connection APIs are outside the agreed native-body scope; a script has no independent socket and must not disconnect the shared game or BB.

mineflayer.Bot.player.reason: User chose an actual native Mob, not a substitute player. The pinned self-player field refers to its own Player entity/player-list entry; no such native record exists. Actual bot.entity and observed nearby players remain available.

mineflayer.Bot.food.reason: User explicitly chose native Mob behavior without player hunger mechanics. Do not present the interaction proxy FoodData as Mob hunger.

mineflayer.Bot.foodSaturation.reason: User explicitly chose native Mob behavior without player hunger/saturation mechanics.

mineflayer.Bot.respawn.reason: User chose native Mob behavior without player respawn or replacement-body mechanics; the pinned method requests PlayerList respawn for a network Player.

mineflayer.Bot.physics.reason: Pinned field is the local player movement predictor. Native Mob physics is authoritative; no client player-physics object or arbitrary predictor mutation applies.

mineflayer.Bot.physicsEnabled.reason: Pinned flag toggles the local player predictor. It must not freeze native Mob gravity/collision or disable execution safeguards.

mineflayer.Bot.acceptResourcePack.reason: Connection resource-pack negotiation is outside the agreed connection API scope. No independent Mob renderer/connection exists; do not acknowledge a pack as loaded or alter the shared client.

mineflayer.Bot.denyResourcePack.reason: Connection resource-pack negotiation is outside the agreed connection API scope; no independent Mob connection receives a request.

mineflayer.BotEvents.resourcePack.reason: Connection-only resource-pack request event; no independent Mob connection exists. Do not fabricate a shared-client request.

evidencePolicy.results: not-recorded means executable indexed without a durable run; passed is accepted only when scenario/report hashes verify. Missing ignored reports remain unverified, not passes.
evidencePolicy.levels: library-differential and serialization are distinct from runtime-boundary, native-integration and live-reference.
evidencePolicy.supported: Requires verified passing native-integration and live-reference evidence. All current native requirements remain pending.
evidencePolicy.referenceServer: User explicitly accepted the Minecraft EULA. The isolated pinned loopback gather run passed with independent server checks; wider reference failures/limitations remain separately recorded.
evidencePolicy.nativeRuns: Historical source-matched native reports are indexed with their limitations and tested revisions where available. They do not validate newer code or establish paired reference conformance.

block-library.scope: Pinned Block/state/harvest/dig/sign scenarios in QuickJS; does not verify native observations.

item-library.scope: Pinned Item registry/component/NBT/anvil scenarios in QuickJS; no native inventory claim.

item-wire.scope: Source-derived wire fixtures and transport checks. Native Java byte probes are separate evidence; do not infer a live reference comparison.

window-library.scope: Window layouts/queries/clicks/events in QuickJS; named upstream corrections checked separately. No authoritative native click proof.

raycast-library.scope: Synthetic typed Block lookup with actual goals, clipping corrections and bounds in QuickJS; not native visibility.

movements-library.scope: Deterministic movement/planner fixtures against upstream; no native movement execution proof.

planning-library.scope: Source/library planning and goal scenarios; no claim that every goal or option is exercised.

runtime-boundary.scope: Worker isolation, awaited bridge operations, cancellation and execution/output bounds; not gameplay conformance.

native-block-observations.scope: Requires known slab/sign/ore fixture and independent native world observations. Availability is not a passing run.

native-item-observations.scope: Requires actual native damaged/component stacks and independently decoded native bytes. Availability is not a passing run.

native-window-observations.scope: Window/item identity, slot queries and equipment; does not exercise container mutations.
native-window-observations.limitations: Native scripted assertions only; no paired live-reference run or full surface conformance.
native-window-observations.independentObservation: No separate independent observation section in this report; do not infer one.

native-raycast-observations.limitations: Native scripted assertions only; no paired live-reference run or full surface conformance.

native-event-observations.scope: Independent fixture mutation, blockUpdate, physicsTick and stable entity identity. Availability is not a passing run.

reviewNotes.prismarine-item.Item: Components/componentMap/removedComponents are source-visible but omitted from declarations; Item.equal ignores components in the pin.
reviewNotes.prismarine-windows.Window: Declarations/docs/runtime disagree on some signatures, layouts and events; windows.mjs separates intended corrections from parity. Drag/double-click (modes 5/6) remain explicit failures, matching pinned api.md:2175–2177 and upstream implementation; not an unported working upstream capability.
reviewNotes.prismarine-world.WorldSync: Full selected columns and sync/async guest cache APIs are implemented. Native full-height/light/biome/sign/freshness and stable references passed selected flat-world checks; storage remains guest-local. Wider loaded worlds/performance require verification.
reviewNotes.mineflayer-pathfinder.Pathfinder: Body-aware planning, native selected edges and bounded shortcuts/direct pursuit implemented. Selected native routes and actual single-node direct following passed. Dynamic/cancel/unsupported physics and larger direct candidates remain pending; no full parity claim.
reviewNotes.events.EventEmitter: Inherited instance surface comes from pinned events 3.3.0, not current Node type declarations. Event payloads/ordering need independent native evidence.
reviewNotes.prismarine-registry.loader.RegistryPc: Pinned PC1.21.1 static tables, shared indexes and version helpers implemented at514a255, with recorded actual QuickJS source comparisons. Native biome IDs/chat formats remain separately hydrated. Dynamic dimension codec methods and richer native registry data remain pending; static login/protocol/commands describe the pin, not live permissions or datapacks. No all-version runtime loader.
reviewNotes.mineflayer-pathfinder.goals.GoalBreakBlo: Use the documented/source deprecated (x,y,z,bot,options) wrapper contract. Pinned index.d.ts incorrectly declares inherited GoalLookAtBlock construction/fields; readme.md:421 and lib/goals.js:209 establish the wrapper. Native adapter accepts bot/world and corrects dropped isEnd(node). No additional inherited-field promise is made from that erroneous declaration.
reviewNotes.mineflayer.Bot.chatPatterns: Pinned docs api.md:964 and index.d.ts:507 specify pattern/type/description records, while chat.js never assigns the field and drops legacy description. Adapter exposes snapshots of active registration regexes (one row per set member) and retains chatAddPattern descriptions; use registration/removal methods to change matching. Documented surface correction; sequential set semantics remain unchanged.
reviewNotes.mineflayer.BotEvents.soundEffectHeard: Pinned lib/plugins/sound.js only handles named_sound_effect and sound_effect packets. World-event (level_event) sounds and client-generated audio do not become this upstream event; no extra level-event/audio renderer observer is required for parity. Native world and proxy packet sound paths are implemented; broader recipient/cancellation coverage remains unverified.
reviewNotes.mineflayer.BotEvents.particle: Pinned lib/plugins/particle.js emits only received world_particles packets. Client-generated particles from local rendering/world events are not emitted by this plugin and do not require copying the human client. Native broadcast/proxy-targeted packet sources are implemented; targeted/range/lifecycle coverage remains unverified.
reviewNotes.prismarine-entity.Entity.metadata: Native complete DataValue wire, bounded registry-aware host decoding and sparse stable guest hydration are implemented at 09b6f0c. Observed resets and changed-only hydrated entityUpdate are preserved; captured pre-pickup Item snapshots remain event-local. Fourteen native-written fixture checks, focused host/QuickJS probes and full build passed. Packaged/live observation and collection verification remain pending. Snapshot semantics do not claim every between-tick packet transition; unknown custom codecs reject. See metadata-native-scenarios.md.
reviewNotes.mineflayer.BotEvents.noteHeard: Native successful block-event and addressed-proxy observations implemented with actual note/instrument state; pinned instrument objects map by serialized name. Full build and focused real-Block/source checks passed; native callbacks remain unverified. See block-events-scenarios.md.
reviewNotes.mineflayer.BotEvents.chestLidMove: Actual native chest type/facing corrects pinned left/right enum reversal; only meaningful lid actions emit and repeated zero counts are suppressed. Bounded cache; full build/source checks only, native verification pending.
reviewNotes.mineflayer.BotEvents.entityAttach: Implemented from actual native vehicle relationships with stable typed identities and cache-boundary retention. Follows documented vehicle meaning; modern native leash links do not overwrite vehicles. Full build passed, native verification pending. See entity-attachment-scenarios.md.
reviewNotes.mineflayer.BotEvents.itemDrop: Implemented for changed nonempty native dropped-item Slots after hydration, not arbitrary firework/display item_stack metadata. Initial state is silent and current observations win over captured event records. Full build passed; native verification pending.
reviewNotes.mineflayer.BotEvents.forcedMove: Still pending. Documented accepted teleports have native Entity.teleportTo counterparts; ordinary native movement must not be inferred as a server correction from a distance threshold. Cross-dimension body/session replacement retains abort semantics. No observer implemented.
